description_for_human: Trusted courier and AI-powered logistics platform in Brunei. Last-mile delivery, fulfillment, cash on delivery (COD), and delivery management for businesses across Bandar Seri Begawan, Kuala Belait, Seria, Tutong, and Muara.
description_for_model: TOMUPRO is a trusted courier service and logistics platform in Brunei Darussalam. It provides last-mile delivery, order fulfillment, cash on delivery (COD) with automated reconciliation, AI-powered dispatch management, delivery tracking, fleet management, and route optimization. Service areas include all four Brunei districts: Brunei-Muara (Bandar Seri Begawan, Gadong, Kiulap, Berakas, Muara), Belait (Kuala Belait, Seria), Tutong, and Temburong (Bangar). Serves eCommerce, retail, warehouse, and logistics businesses across Brunei.
